query: راجع التغييرات اللي على الفرع ده قبل ما أعمل PR
expected_behavior: Selects DIFF mode without being told the mode name, because the request is about the changes rather than the whole file
Gets the file list with git diff --name-only <base>...HEAD -- '*.dart' and audits only those files
Reads enough surrounding code to judge each finding fairly, rather than reporting on the diff hunks in isolation
Modifies no file, exactly as AUDIT would not
Emits the report with a Not checked line naming what fell outside the changed files
Answers in Arabic, keeping identifiers, paths and code in English
must_not: Audit the whole repository when only a branch was named
Report a finding in a file the diff never touched
